videos.title: Cem Karsan Says You're Trading With One Arm Tied Behind You
videos.description:
Cem Karsan of Kai Volatility has a blunt message: if you're trading this market without understanding the structural flows, you're playing with one arm strapped behind your back. Daily flows structurally sell volatility, December carries one of the largest options expirations ever, and skew sits among the three highest readings of the last decade. Every day that passes brings vol compression and delta buyback. He's equally clear the macro is bad and will get worse, but the flows keep pushing higher.
